title: May 2026 Submission Update
description: A May update on WordPress plugin submission prep, Internal Links Audit progress, and the near-term Kreativ WP roadmap.
metaDescription: A May 2026 update on WordPress plugin submission prep, Internal Links Audit progress, and the near-term Kreativ WP roadmap.
intro: Work this month is centered on plugin review and submission prep, with Internal Links Audit still leading the next release queue.

items.title: Submission work is the immediate priority
items.body: Current effort is focused on checking plugin state, tightening submission details, and getting WordPress.org packaging and review materials in order.

items.title: Internal Links Audit remains next
items.body: Kreativ Internal Links Audit is still the next release candidate, but the public status is now framed around submission prep and release scoping rather than an expired April target.

items.title: Smart Related Posts stays behind it
items.body: Kreativ Smart Related Posts remains in the near-term pipeline, but it stays positioned after Internal Links Audit while the current submission work is completed.
